hypothesis: If the generated ERA5 pressure-level Zarr pipeline preserves the validated one-time, one-pressure-level, full-latitude/full-longitude chunk topology and changes only the explicit lossless data-array codec from Blosc-Zstd clevel 7 bitshuffle to Blosc-Zstd clevel 9 bitshuffle, then output_bytes may decrease because the measured artifact is dominated by compressed float32 chunk payloads and previous weaker/faster encodings were larger. reflection: The parent is feasible and passes all hard constraints with exact semantic comparison. Its diagnostics show output_bytes 108,202,642 with chunk_bytes 108,165,249 and metadata_bytes only 37,393, so footprint is overwhelmingly controlled by data chunk encoding. Prior measured variants that weakened compression for throughput or balance had larger outputs: Blosc-Zstd clevel 3 about 111.16 MB, LZ4 bitshuffle about 128.43 MB, LZ4/shuffle about 168.8 MB, and uncompressed about 348.9 MB. The bounded footprint mutation should therefore keep the validated sample-aligned full-spatial chunk topology and exact publication/contract behavior, and only increase the deterministic lossless Zstd compression strength from the parent’s high but not maximum Blosc-Zstd clevel 7 bitshuffle setting to clevel 9 bitshuffle, accepting possible slower materialization because only output_bytes is scheduled.
